# gramlot-js-server 0.2.10

- Forward Page locale and timeZone through Worker registration and standalone startup so serverless formatting uses the same context as HTTP pages.
- Document page/call/browser precedence and extend startup tests.
- Align the three package versions and require the current core/examples capabilities without upper dependency bounds.

Verified with the serverless suite and real Chromium/WebKit single-file and directory exports using page locale/timezone and live formatting/pointer transforms. The Node and project-generator tests are included in the release verification workflow.
